plainLanguage: R.E. 2022 haijaweka substantive offence katika section 44; inaonyesha kuwa provision hiyo ilibadilishwa ('Replaced') na C.A. 2 of 1962 section 36.
meaning: The current Penal Code text does not supply operative section 44 wording here. The replacement notation is a legislative-history marker and should not be expanded into a current offence without consulting the cited constitutional/legal instrument.
keyPoints: The notation cites C.A. 2 of 1962 s. 36.
No substantive current offence text appears under section 44 in R.E. 2022.
Historical or replacement content must be sourced separately.

legalTerms.meaning: Notation ya legislative history kwamba provision ya awali ilibadilishwa na instrument iliyotajwa.

history.summary: R.E. 2022 states: Replaced by C.A. 2 of 1962 s. 36.
notes: The library preserves that status rather than inventing the former or replacement wording.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: A replaced section should remain visibly marked as such so users do not mistake historical numbering for an operative offence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: A future historical note should link directly to the cited 1962 instrument or another authoritative legislative source.

debateQuestion: Ni authoritative source gani inaonyesha full legal effect ya replacement iliyofanywa na C.A. 2 of 1962 s. 36?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
